IV. CONCLUSION
Summit’s S‑Corporation eligibility issues are severe, multi‑year, and likely to be viewed by the IRS as significant compliance failures. Corrective action is possible only through coordinated remediation and a §1362(f) relief request. Without corrective actions, Summit may be treated as a C‑Corporation for all periods beginning June 1, 2022, or earlier if disproportionate distributions are deemed to create a second class of stock.
This memorandum reflects a partner‑level diligence summary and may be circulated to tax counsel, buy‑side advisors, and internal decision-makers as part of a broader transaction risk analysis.
